properties.name: cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: Cloudinary account cloud name for media storage.

properties.name: cloudinary.api-key
properties.description: Cloudinary API key for authentication.

properties.name: cloudinary.api-secret
properties.description: Cloudinary API secret for authentication.

properties.name: auth.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the authentication service (used for JWT validation and inter-service communication).

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens. Must match across all microservices.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT access token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration
properties.description: JWT refresh token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: message.delivery.retry-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed message delivery to users.

properties.name: message.delivery.retry-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between message delivery retry attempts with exponential backoff.

properties.name: message.idempotency-timeout-hours
properties.description: Duration in hours to keep idempotency keys for preventing duplicate message sends.

properties.name: profile-views.max-history-size
properties.description: Maximum number of profile view history entries to retain per user.

properties.name: rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests allowed per minute per client IP address.

properties.name: rate-limit.websocket-messages-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of WebSocket STOMP messages allowed per minute per connected client.

properties.name: websocket.stomp.heartbeat.client
properties.description: STOMP heartbeat interval in milliseconds that clients send to the server.

properties.name: websocket.stomp.heartbeat.server
properties.description: STOMP heartbeat interval in milliseconds that the server sends to connected clients.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Prefix for async task executor thread names for easier debugging in logs.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.core-size
properties.description: Core number of threads in the async task executor thread pool.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.max-size
properties.description: Maximum number of threads in the async task executor thread pool.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.queue-capacity
properties.description: Queue capacity for async tasks waiting to be executed.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.wait-for-tasks-to-complete-on-shutdown
properties.description: Whether to wait for remaining async tasks to complete on application shutdown.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.await-termination-period
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for async tasks to complete on shutdown.

properties.name: feign.client.config.default.connect-timeout
properties.description: Feign HTTP client connection timeout in milliseconds for inter-service calls.

properties.name: feign.client.config.default.read-timeout
properties.description: Feign HTTP client read timeout in milliseconds for inter-service calls.

properties.name: feign.compression.request.enabled
properties.description: Enable GZIP compression for Feign HTTP requests.

properties.name: feign.compression.request.min-request-size
properties.description: Minimum request size in bytes before Feign applies compression.

properties.name: server.tomcat.max-http-form-post-size
properties.description: Maximum size in bytes for HTTP form POST requests.

properties.name: server.tomcat.connection-timeout
properties.description: Tomcat connection timeout for establishing HTTP connections.

properties.name: server.tomcat.threads.max
properties.description: Maximum number of request processing threads in Tomcat.

properties.name: server.tomcat.threads.min-spare
properties.description: Minimum number of spare request processing threads in Tomcat.

properties.name: server.tomcat.max-connections
properties.description: Maximum number of connections Tomcat will accept.

properties.name: server.compression.enabled
properties.description: Enable response compression (gzip) for responses larger than min-response-size.

properties.name: server.compression.min-response-size
properties.description: Minimum response size in bytes before compression is applied.

properties.name: server.port
properties.description: Server HTTP port.

properties.name: server.shutdown
properties.description: Server shutdown strategy (immediate, graceful).

properties.name: server.servlet.context-path
properties.description: Context path of the web application.

properties.name: spring.data.mongodb.connection-string
properties.description: MongoDB connection string URI (replaces deprecated uri property).

properties.name: spring.data.mongodb.auto-index-creation
properties.description: Enable automatic MongoDB index creation from @Indexed annotations.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.url
properties.description: Redis server URL connection string.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.timeout
properties.description: Redis connection timeout duration.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.connect-timeout
properties.description: Redis connection establish timeout duration.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.lettuce.pool.max-active
properties.description: Maximum number of active connections in Redis Lettuce connection pool.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.lettuce.pool.max-idle
properties.description: Maximum number of idle connections in Redis Lettuce connection pool.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.lettuce.pool.min-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle connections in Redis Lettuce connection pool.

properties.name: spring.cache.type
properties.description: Cache type to use (redis, caffeine, simple, none).

properties.name: spring.cache.redis.time-to-live
properties.description: Default cache TTL for all Redis caches.

properties.name: spring.cache.cache-names
properties.description: List of cache names to initialize on startup.

properties.name: spring.jackson.default-property-inclusion
properties.description: Inclusion strategy for serializing properties (non_null = exclude null values).

properties.name: spring.jackson.serialization.write-dates-as-timestamps
properties.description: Whether to write dates as timestamps (false = use ISO-8601 format).

properties.name: spring.jackson.deserialization.fail-on-unknown-properties
properties.description: Whether to fail if unknown properties are found during deserialization.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed file size per upload.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.max-request-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed request size for multipart uploads.

properties.name: spring.security.user.name
properties.description: Default user name for basic authentication.

properties.name: spring.security.user.password
properties.description: Default user password for basic authentication.

properties.name: logging.level.root
properties.description: Root logger level.

properties.name: logging.pattern.console
properties.description: Log pattern for console output.

properties.name: logging.file.name
properties.description: Log file name and path.

properties.name: logging.file.max-size
properties.description: Maximum size of log file before rotation.

properties.name: logging.file.max-history
properties.description: Maximum number of backup log files to keep.

properties.name: logging.file.total-size-cap
properties.description: Total size cap for all log files combined.

properties.name: management.endpoints.web.base-path

properties.name: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.show-details
properties.description: When to show health details: never, when-authorized, always.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.livenessState.enabled

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.readinessState.enabled
properties.description: Enable the readiness state for Kubernetes readiness probes.

properties.name: management.endpoint.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable the metrics management endpoint.

properties.name: management.metrics.export.prometheus.enabled
properties.description: Enable Prometheus metrics export at /actuator/prometheus endpoint.

properties.name: management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram.[messenger.message.send.latency]

properties.name: management.metrics.tags.application
properties.description: Application name tag for metrics.

Warn level - warning messages for potential issues.

Fatal level - only critical errors that cause shutdown.
Off - disable logging for this logger completely.
Root logger level - applies to all loggers unless overridden.
